recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-3977 unless a future work group decision reintroduces a comparable ValueSet inline-code-system invariant in the current model.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 technical correction for FHIR-core ValueSet. The issue reported that Inv-7 failed when ValueSet.identifier was absent and requested the XPath be changed to not(f:define/f:system/@value = f:identifier/@value).
initial_application: The Jira comment says fixed svn 4055. Git commit 87833681e38f85c6bd683317732c672ffd9dc7dc maps to that SVN revision and changed source/valueset/valueset-spreadsheet.xml from not(exists(f:define)) or (f:define/f:system/@value != f:identifier/@value) to not(f:define/f:system/@value = f:identifier/@value).
additional_context: The corrected invariant belonged to the retired DSTU1/R2 spreadsheet source model where ValueSet.define represented an inline code system definition. Current build scope uses the active valueset=ValueSet resource entry in source/fhir.ini and source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml. The old spreadsheet source was deleted during later source refresh work.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The issue's requested correction was applied historically, and the modern ValueSet source has no ValueSet.define element, no vsd-7 constraint, and no f:define/f:system XPath to correct.
